card.name: Words before abstract noun in old science prose
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words just before an expected abstract noun such as resemblance, parallelism, terrorism, foundation or fit. It appears in older scientific and encyclopedic prose, not in drug labels.

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: An adjective or partial word that leads into a noun like parallelism, resemblance or fit.
modes.example: there is a<< striking>> general parallelism in the successive Silur

modes.label: Linking word after a noun
modes.description: A word like of or in that follows an abstract noun and leads into a described thing.
modes.example: a state<< of>> terrorism quickly prevailed in the district.

card.plain: It marks the spot in old-style scientific writing where a word like resemblance or parallelism is about to follow.
